body.label: Effect
body.html: On a success, deal 1 weapon damage. If it has not yet acted this round, it suffers -1 Defense against this Action.

surges.html: If this Action has only one target, deal +1 weapon damage.
If you moved at least 3 units before this Action, deal +1 weapon damage.

rider.title: OPENER
rider.html: If you began this Action with no Combo and deal damage, make the target Exposed.
